sourceEditFollowup.native: After reopening the pair, editing the first source endpoint from 10 to 20 mm refreshed the target from [5,0,0] to [5,4,0] into [7.5,0,0] to [7.5,4,0]. The constructed mode, source names, displayed endpoints and 4 mm length remained after saving to a separate QSF and reopening it.
sourceEditFollowup.applicationAndMcp: The GUI-created pair refreshed to the same displayed geometry after a public MCP source edit, preserved its definition, and passed public MCP undo/redo and project-worker reopen.
sourceEditFollowup.cleanup: Both owned jobs exited with zero active processes, closed handles, no cleanup errors or overrun, and released mutexes; native 74.98 seconds and browser 45.06 seconds.

nativeSavedRecordReadback.scope: Strict bounded readback of the two native-authored three-line QSFs, not a general QSF reader.
nativeSavedRecordReadback.verification: The parser matched the established single-object point and line reader, rejected six malformed in-memory inputs, checked both index tables and consumed each bounded record exactly. Each native source identity is listed as a target dependency and each source lists the target as a dependent in both files.
nativeSavedRecordReadback.pairRecords: In both QSFs the target mode is 3, its two ordered records reference the corresponding first and second source identities, and both 12-byte pick suffixes are all zero. Stored F64 endpoints are [5,0,0] to [5,4,0] before the source edit and [7.5,0,0] to [7.5,4,0] after it.
nativeSavedRecordReadback.applicationDifference: The tested application route supplies explicit midpoint fractions and retains [5,0,0] and [5,4,0] as F32 pick coordinates. It does not reproduce the native dropdown's zero-valued records, even though this fixture's displayed geometry matches. Native dropdown acquisition parity remains open.

limitations: The source choices came from native dropdowns; no viewport-picked locations were confirmed. The result is one parallel-line fixture and does not establish general native source-location rules.
The native average picker remained at zero selected after a visible line click. The experiment was cancelled; no average result or persistence claim is made.

The native dropdown selected sources without explicit fractions and retained zero pick suffixes, while the application comparison supplied 0.5 for each and retained midpoint coordinates; the single source edit does not establish identical acquisition semantics or equivalent fallback diagnostics.
This checkpoint does not complete M4 or authorize merge or milestone closure.
